Class AetherisNotebookPanel

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
org.aetheris.swing.AetherisNotebookPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible, AmwpClientListener
public class AetherisNotebookPanel extends JPanel implements AmwpClientListener
The AetherisNotebookPanel is the notebook surface on tab B. The panel is a JPanel. The panel paints three regions on that tab. The canvas is the row of conversation cards. The inspector is the text pane beside the canvas. The footer is the control bar under the canvas. The panel implements AmwpClientListener so an AMWP frame can arrive on this surface. AMWP is the frame type AmwpFrame that a session sends to this client. The canvas record lives in the client vault, the store named CLIENT-SOT. CLIENT-SOT means the client vault is the source of truth for the canvas conversation. The panel does not draw a graph of that conversation. A caller builds the panel with a theme, a worker, a yaml file, a AetherisNotebookPanel.Host, and a point size. The AetherisNotebookPanel.Host is the application side that owns the focused session and the saved shell numbers. // @aa-sdd S1-09 G-12 G-17 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md

  • Constructor Details

    • AetherisNotebookPanel

      public AetherisNotebookPanel(SshClientTheme theme, AetherisWorker worker, AetherisYaml yaml, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host host, int fontSize)
      The constructor builds the notebook panel and fills it. The layout is a BorderLayout. The token-edit queue starts before the fields are stored. A point size under 8 is stored as 8. The open-card row count comes from AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.shellViewRows(). A row count under 1 is stored as 1. Soft wrap on the inspector starts on. The complex filter starts off. The view modal starts closed. The extra footer tools start closed. The constructor reads the hide record, the settings record, and the expanded-view record. Hide-collapsed turns on only when that hide record is present, not blocked, and marked hide. Debug mood turns on only when the settings record is present, not blocked, and marked debug. Tooltips stay on when the settings record is absent. Tooltips follow the settings record when that record is present. Painted borders turn on only when the settings record is present, not blocked, and marked borders. The center of the panel is the canvas and inspector split. The south of the panel is the thinking strip and the footer. The constructor then installs the error slide, the tab listener, the hotkeys, the font, the divider memory, and the caption clock.
      Parameters:
      theme - the SshClientTheme that supplies the panel colors
      worker - the AetherisWorker that performs the JDBC calls and the AMWP calls
      yaml - the AetherisYaml loaded from aetheris.yaml
      host - the application AetherisNotebookPanel.Host this panel calls
      fontSize - the control-panel point size, raised to 8 when the argument is lower

  • Method Details

    • installCaptionClock

      private void installCaptionClock()
      The method starts the one caption clock on the panel. The caption is the clock-and-model line on the focused cell. Swing paints that line across the cell border. The cell keeps its size. The timer fires every 1000 milliseconds, repeats, and starts immediately. Each tick calls repaintCellCaption().

    • repaintCellCaption

      private void repaintCellCaption()
      The method asks the canvas column to paint the focused-cell caption again. The caption is the clock-and-model line on that cell. The method returns without painting when the focused card is missing. The method returns without painting when the card has no scroll pane or no viewport. A missing view inside the viewport is left alone.

    • stampLine

      private String stampLine(CellRecord cell)
      The method builds the caption line for one cell. The caption is the local clock plus the short model name. The clock is read when the line is asked for. The clock pattern is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss. A merge cell uses mergeInputModels(CellRecord) for the model text. Any other cell uses the short name of executionTarget. A blank model keeps the clock alone. The clock and the model are joined with a middle dot.
      Parameters:
      cell - the card the caption is for
      Returns:
      the caption words, or an empty string when cell is absent

    • mergeInputModels

      private String mergeInputModels(CellRecord sink)
      The method lists the short model names of the input cells in this merge. The names stay in deck order. A pipe separates the names. The merge cell's own target stays off the line. An input cell is a sibling whose group id matches and whose column position is greater than 0. A blank short name is skipped.
      Parameters:
      sink - the merge output cell
      Returns:
      the names, or an empty string when sink is absent, the group id is empty, the canvas is absent, or the group has no named input

    • cellCaptionText

      private String cellCaptionText(CellRecord cell)
      The method returns the caption words for the focused cell. A cell that is not the focused cell stays blank. A blank model keeps the clock alone, because the words come from stampLine(CellRecord). The flank beside those words is a stroke painted later. The flank is not part of this string.
      Parameters:
      cell - the card under the pointer, or the armed card
      Returns:
      the caption words, or an empty string when cell is absent, the id is absent, or the id is not the focused cell

    • captionRule

      private int captionRule(FontMetrics fm)
      The method measures one caption flank. A flank is the short stroke painted on one side of the caption words. The width is two widths of the character 0. That width is the span the box rule used to take. A character width under 1 is treated as 8.
      Parameters:
      fm - the monospace FontMetrics for the caption font
      Returns:
      the flank width in pixels

    • captionGap

      private int captionGap(FontMetrics fm)
      The method measures the gap between a caption flank and the caption words. The width is the width of one space. A space width under 1 is treated as 4.
      Parameters:
      fm - the monospace FontMetrics for the caption font
      Returns:
      the gap in pixels

    • captionSpan

      private int captionSpan(FontMetrics fm, String text)
      The method measures the full caption band. The band is one flank, one gap, the words, one gap, and the other flank. The flanks come from captionRule(FontMetrics). The gaps come from captionGap(FontMetrics).
      Parameters:
      fm - the monospace FontMetrics for the caption font
      text - the caption words
      Returns:
      the band width in pixels

    • captionRect

      private Rectangle captionRect(AetherisNotebookPanel.CellCard card)
      The method builds the caption box in the focused card's coordinates. The vertical center of the box sits on the top stroke of the card. A wide line keeps the right end and loses its left. The right end stays CAPTION_PAD pixels in from the card width. The left end also stays at least CAPTION_PAD pixels in from the left. A card with no caption words has no box. A card whose width, text height, text width, or shown width is under 1 has no box.
      Parameters:
      card - the focused card
      Returns:
      the box, or null when card is absent or this card wears no line

    • captionContains

      private boolean captionContains(Component source, Point point)
      The method tests whether a pointer point lies on the focused cell's caption. The point is converted from source into the focused card. The test uses the box from captionRect(CellCard).
      Parameters:
      source - the component that holds the point
      point - the point in that component
      Returns:
      true when the point is on the embedded caption line, and false when the card, the source, the point, or the box is absent

      private void installDividerPersistence()
      The method remembers the canvas and inspector bar. The bar is the divider in canvasSplit. A one-shot timer of 400 milliseconds calls saveDividerRatio(). The timer does not repeat.       private void queueDividerRestore()
      The method applies a saved divider ratio after the split has a real width. The method returns when the divider is already restored, a restore is already queued, or the split is absent. The method returns when the split width is under 32. A passing call sets the queued flag and runs applySavedDivider() later on the event thread.

    • applySavedDivider

      private void applySavedDivider()
      The method places the divider from the shell. The method returns when the divider is already restored or the split is absent. The span is the split width minus the divider size. A span under 32 returns before the restored flag is set. The restored flag is set before the saved number is tested. An absent key is a value under 0. A value over 1000 is also ignored. Either ignored value leaves the preferred layout in place. A value from 0 to 1000 sets the divider location to that share of the span. The applying flag is true only while setDividerLocation runs.

    • saveDividerRatio

      private void saveDividerRatio()
      The method writes the live left share of the divider. The share is per mille, which is parts per thousand of the span. The method is skipped until the bar has been realized. Realized means dividerRestored is true and the split is present. A span under 32 returns without a write. The location is clamped from 0 through the span. The per-mille value is rounded and then clamped from 0 through 1000. A value equal to AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.shellInspectorDivider() is not written again. Any other value is passed to AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.shellInspectorDividerChanged(int).

    • fitAetherisButton

      private void fitAetherisButton(AbstractButton button)
      The method fits one notebook button to the live point size. The client property aetheris.short is set. The preferred size and the maximum size are cleared before the font is applied. A missing font starts as sans serif at uiFontSize. A bar button skips the shrink and keeps the app point size. A button that is not a bar button takes a flat border, and the bevel stays. That button's target height is 70 percent of the flat-border height, and the target is at least 1. The point size then steps down from uiFontSize while it is still above 8 and the preferred height is over the target. A bar button's height is the preferred height minus 4, and that height is at least 1. The preferred width stays the measured width. The maximum height is the fitted height, and the maximum width is the largest integer. holdShortLabel(AbstractButton) then keeps the specified text on the button.

    • holdShortLabel

      private static void holdShortLabel(AbstractButton button)
      The method keeps a short button wide enough and tall enough for its text. The short fit can lock a width under the word and a height under the word. A null button returns immediately. The current preferred size is remembered, and then the preferred, minimum, and maximum sizes are cleared. A missing label is measured as an empty string. A missing font is measured as sans serif at 12 points. A missing inset set is treated as zeros. A label of one or two characters, and any label already under its word, takes two ems after the border is on. An em here is the width of M, and a width under 1 is treated as 1. A remembered width that is already larger is kept. The height stays the short fit when the word fits, and rises when the short fit is under the word. A bar button then loses 5 pixels. The width and the height are at least 1. The button text stays the specified text. The maximum width is the largest integer, and the maximum height is the fitted height.
      Parameters:
      button - a short chrome button

    • bindUser

      public void bindUser(String username, int epoch)
      The method writes the open vault, then opens username. The call stores epoch as the bind generation before the work is queued. A newer epoch wins. The queued task checks the generation before the persist, before the open, and before the swap. A stale generation returns without closing a vault it did not open, except that an already opened store is closed when the generation changed after open. A present previous vault is persisted with persistAll. The new store is a VaultStore built from yaml and username, then opened, then loaded or created. The previous store is closed only when it is still the panel's vault. The event-thread paint reloads the expanded-view record, clears concealed ids, rebuilds the tabs, and tells the host the vault is shown. An exception posts vault error: plus the exception message as the status.
      Parameters:
      username - the SSH user to open
      epoch - the focus generation

    • acceptFrame

      public void acceptFrame(String username, AmwpFrame frame)
      The method keeps a Scope A frame for username and handles the other frame kinds that arrive here. Scope A is a data frame on channel A. Paint runs only while that vault is open, on the paths that compare username with openUsername(). A mood-wire cell returns before the ordinary paint. A data frame on channel A dispatches by the text prefix and then returns. effort_off: marks that cell's effort off. show_result: applies the show result. tags_result: applies the tag result. grok_models_result: applies the Grok model list. A reply with no model lines is the red miss. shell_model_result: applies the shell-model result when that result was armed to open the dialog. session_tokens_result: stores used, chars, and blocks when all three lines parse. A bad number on that tally returns without storing. The canvas transfer flag stays during the tally store. session_export_result: applies the export only when the transfer flag was set, and the flag is cleared either way. session_replace_result: applies the replace result. A delta on the stream channel seats a think chunk for that user. The glass shows the chunk only when that user's armed scope is the open pane. A kind of c paints a pool chunk only for the open user. An empty delta payload returns. A data frame on the stream channel appends a mood reply when the cell is the mood wire and the cell id matches. A stop on that frame marks the cell cancelled and clears the run. Any other stream answer is remembered, the think is finished, the run is cleared, and pending paint is applied. An error on the mood wire fails the mood when the cell id matches. A stop on an error marks the cell cancelled. A structured reason cell-busy sets that status for the open user and returns. Any other error marks the cell failed, clears the chain queue, and may show the error slide. The slide shows when the cell is grouped or the notice is not graceful. The slide is yellow when the miss is soft and not hard. A structured error status uses the reason. An unstructured error status uses failed, and the stored failure word is FAILED. An end-of-file frame clears the run unless a stop marks the cell cancelled first. A mood-wire end-of-file returns without clearing the run.
      Parameters:
      username - the sanitized vault user the frame belongs to
      frame - a Scope A frame or a stream frame

A focused cell that is missing or not phase RUNNING does the same. The focused cell's phase becomes STOPPED. The spinner stops when no sibling cell is still running. The status becomes Stopped. A worker task writes an empty cancel payload for that cell. A late reply for that cell does not paint, because consumeStop(String, String) sees the stopped phase. A failed write sets the status to Stop failed: plus the message when that user is still open.

A connector that is not AMWP sets the status to raw console has no Roux export and returns. A missing conversation table sets the status to replace failed: no canvas and returns. A body that does not fit one frame sets the status to replace failed: the session does not fit in one frame and returns. Any other path writes session_replace: plus the table. After OK, the method sends the cells. Roux stays until the server accepts the table.

      The method storeHideChoice writes the Hide Collapsed flag when it differs from the stored record. A null hideSeat returns without writing. A blocked record returns without writing. A flag that already matches hideCollapsed returns without writing. The in-memory record is replaced through AetherisNotebookPanel.HideSeat.withHide(boolean) before the write.     • parseHideYaml

      static AetherisNotebookPanel.HideSeat parseHideYaml(String text)
      The method parseHideYaml reads version 1 text of aetheris-hide.yaml into a AetherisNotebookPanel.HideSeat. A null text returns AetherisNotebookPanel.HideSeat.blocked(). A leading byte-order mark is removed before the empty check. A text that is empty or only whitespace returns a blocked record. Lines are split on \n. A line that ends with a carriage return loses that character. A line that starts with --- or % is skipped until the first key. A blank line is skipped until the first key. A top-level line needs a colon and a name that yamlKey(String) accepts. Any other top-level shape returns a blocked record. The key version must appear once and must pass versionOne(String). A second version key returns a blocked record. A version that is not 1 returns a blocked record. The key hide_collapsed may appear once. A second hide_collapsed key returns a blocked record. A value that hideFlag(String) cannot read returns a blocked record. A missing hide_collapsed key leaves the flag false. Any other top-level key is kept, with the following indented lines, in extras. A blank indented line under a kept key is skipped. An indented line that is not under a kept key returns a blocked record when it is not blank. A non-blank line before the first key returns a blocked record. A missing version key returns a blocked record. A readable text returns a record that is not blocked.
      Parameters:
      text - the file text, or null
      Returns:
      the parsed record, or a blocked record when the text is not version 1

An IOException while reading returns a fresh record. An empty file returns AetherisNotebookPanel.HideSeat.blocked(). Any other bytes are decoded as UTF-8. The decoded text is passed to parseHideYaml(String).
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      the parsed record, a fresh record when the file is missing, or a blocked record when the file is empty

      private static AetherisNotebookPanel.ExpandedSeat parseExpandedYaml(String text)
      The method parseExpandedYaml reads version 1 text of aetheris-expanded.yaml. A null text returns AetherisNotebookPanel.ExpandedSeat.blocked(). A leading byte-order mark is removed before the empty check. A text that is empty or only whitespace returns a blocked record. Lines are split on \n. A line that ends with a carriage return loses that character. A line that starts with --- or % is skipped until the first key. A blank line is skipped until the first key. A top-level line needs a colon and a name that yamlKey(String) accepts. Any other top-level shape returns a blocked record. The key version must appear once and must pass versionOne(String). A second version key returns a blocked record. A version that is not 1 returns a blocked record. The key cells with an empty value, or a value that starts with #, starts a nested id list. A cells value that is only a brace pair, or a value that starts with a left brace, is read by seatInlineExpanded(String, ArrayList). A false result from that read returns a blocked record. Nested lines that follow an inline cells value are still read as ids. Any other cells shape returns a blocked record. A nested line that is blank or starts with # is skipped. A nested line needs a colon and a name that yamlKey(String) accepts. A nested value that hideFlag(String) reads as true is passed to pushExpandedId(ArrayList, String). A nested value that is not true is ignored. A bad nested line returns a blocked record. A line under an unknown top-level key is kept in extras. A non-blank line before the first key returns a blocked record. A missing version key returns a blocked record. The kept ids are sorted before the record is returned.

      private void deleteFocusedTurn()
      The method deleteFocusedTurn removes the armed card, or the whole group when that card carries a group id. The canvas keeps at least one cell. A missing canvas returns without a delete. A missing vault returns without a delete. An empty removal set refreshes Delete and returns. A removal set that covers every cell on the canvas refreshes Delete and returns. The cells that stay are the ordered cells whose ids are not removed. A null ordered cell is skipped. An empty remaining list refreshes Delete and returns. Focus moves to the cell that followed the first removed cell. Focus moves to the last remaining cell when that follower is missing. A non-empty group id deletes the group. A mood pin that is not head and is among the removed ids walks to the previous remaining cell. That walk uses head when the removed pin was the first remaining slot. The removed ids are buried. Their runs are cancelled. A chain that names them is dropped. The group timer is stopped. armedGroupSource is cleared when it is one of the removed ids. The vault delete runs on the worker. A successful delete removes those cells, rewrites cellOrder, and moves focus. A mood walk that is present is stored and saved. Think state, expanded-view marks, and edit memory for the removed ids are dropped. The status line is deleted group on or deleted turn on, followed by the canvas name. An SQLException unburies the ids. The failure status is delete group failed: or delete turn failed:, followed by the exception message.

      private void dispatchCell(CellRecord target)
      The method dispatchCell sends one cell on the focused AMWP session. A null cell returns without a send. A cell that is not readable returns without a send. A merge cell, a non-empty group id with columnPosition 0, returns without a send. A missing connector, or a connector that is not AMWP, shows Aetheris tab needs an AMWP session. An empty vault user shows Vault is still opening. A null or empty focused user shows that same line. A vault user that is not the focused user shows that same line. A Grok target with no model after the slash is marked FAILED, saved quietly, and shows no-model. The air-gap judgment stays on the casserole server. A reply whose reason is air-gap uses that reason as the status. An ephemeral cloud target is marked FAILED and shows burner denied unless the provider is Grok and the cell allows burner cloud.       private void persistAll() throws SQLException
      The method persistAll saves every open canvas through the current vault. A null vault returns without a save. A buried cell id is skipped. Every other cell is saved with VaultStore.saveCell(CellRecord). Each canvas order is saved after its cells.

    • rememberAnswer

      private void rememberAnswer(String username, String cellId, String text)
      The method rememberAnswer stores one reply text for a later paint. A null or empty user name returns without a store. A null or empty cell id returns without a store. A missing AetherisNotebookPanel.UserRun for that user is created and stored. A null text is stored as an empty string. The map update holds runLock.

    • applyPendingNow

      private void applyPendingNow(String username)
      The method applyPendingNow paints held answers for one user onto the open canvases. The save uses the vault captured at the start, not a store that becomes current later. A null user name, a null vault, or a null canvas list returns without a paint. A user name that is not the vault user returns without a paint. A missing run, or a run with no held answers, returns without a paint. A buried cell drops its held answer and is not painted. Any other held cell copies the answer into assistantText and sets executionStatus to COMPLETED. A painted cell that is last on its canvas clears the pending focus and lands on the input. A painted cell that is not last aims the pending focus at the assistant text. grew stays true after any last-cell paint, even if a later cell is not last. A buried id that still has a held answer is dropped with the painted ids. An idle run with no remaining answers is removed. No painted cell returns before the save. The painted cells are absorbed, saved, and each one arms a group wait. The chain advances on those cells. grew true appends a turn. grew false rebuilds the tabs and refreshes the inspector.
      Parameters:
      username - the sanitized vault user, or null

      The method saveCells saves a list of cells on the worker. A null cell is skipped. A buried cell is skipped. Each other cell is saved with VaultStore.saveCell(CellRecord). An SQLException stores the assistant text again through rememberAnswer(String, String, String).

      store - the vault captured for this save
      username - the vault user
      cells - the cells to save

      private void persistQuiet(CellRecord cell)
      The method persistQuiet saves one cell on the worker and ignores a database failure. The vault is the one current when this method is called. A null vault returns without a save. A null cell returns without a save. A buried cell returns without a save. An SQLException is ignored.

      cell - the cell to save, or null

    • seatMark

      private void seatMark(CellRecord cell, CellState state)
      The method seatMark writes one mark onto a cell. The marks are the included, excluded, input-only, and output-only states. A null cell returns without a write. A null state returns without a write. The press stores state on the cell. Focus and release do not call this method. repairCanvasLocks() runs after the store. A card that is on screen paints the mark. A missing card still saves the cell. The cell is saved quietly and the inspector is refreshed. The deck is not rebuilt.
      Parameters:
      cell - the turn, or null
      state - the mark, or null

    • repairCanvasLocks

      private void repairCanvasLocks()
      The method repairCanvasLocks keeps the canvas locks a packed prefix after a mark press. A missing canvas returns without a change. A null cell is treated as excluded and unlocked. CanvasHead.repair(CellState[], boolean[], int) receives the states, the locks, and headCountFact(). A cell whose lock already matches the repaired value is left alone. A cell whose lock changes is saved quietly.

    • showsCanvasLock

      private boolean showsCanvasLock(CellRecord cell)
      The method showsCanvasLock reports whether this card shows the head lock. The lock is the padlock at the far left of the button bar. A missing canvas returns false. A null cell returns false. A null ordered cell is treated as excluded. The index is the position of cell in canvas order, or -1 when it is absent. The result is CanvasHead.showsLock(CellState[], int, int).
      Parameters:
      cell - the card, or null
      Returns:
      true when this card shows the padlock

    • pressCanvasLock

      private void pressCanvasLock(CellRecord cell)
      The method pressCanvasLock presses the lock on one card. A miss leaves the prefix. A missing canvas returns without a change. A null cell returns without a change. A null ordered cell is treated as excluded and unlocked. CanvasHead.press(CellState[], boolean[], int, int) receives the states, the locks, headCountFact(), and the card index. A card that is not in the order passes index -1. A cell whose lock already matches is left alone. A changed lock is saved quietly. No change returns without a rebuild. A change rebuilds the tabs and refreshes the inspector.
      Parameters:
      cell - the card, or null

      The method applyCellText writes the undo record into the card that is on screen. A rebuilt card is found by id. A missing card calls EditMemory.endApply() and returns. A card with a null prompt does the same. The prompt text becomes EditMemory.text(), and a null text becomes empty. The caret is placed with seatCellCaret(JTextArea, int). A second placement runs on the event thread after Swing's own caret step, and that task ends the apply. A RuntimeException ends the apply and is thrown again.

      private String pinFoldTip()

The text says the pin checkbox stays as it was. The text says the choice is saved with the shell. The text says green means the pin is on.     • buildCanvasDeck

      private JComponent buildCanvasDeck()
      The method buildCanvasDeck builds the panel that holds canvasTabs. canvasTabs is the tab component for the canvas cards. The deck uses a null layout and paints with the theme. P is not added here. P sits on the inspector bar. The deck reports the preferred size and the minimum size of canvasTabs. Layout gives canvasTabs the whole deck and then lays those tabs out.

    • buildPinBar

      private JPanel buildPinBar()
      The method buildPinBar builds the pin bar that sits above the canvas cards. The bar is a left-to-right row with a 6-pixel gap. The theme paints the bar. The empty border is 2 pixels tall and 8 pixels on each side. The bar is visible when AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.shellPinBarOpen() is true. The P button is visible when that call is false. v uses pinFoldTip() and folds the bar. P uses pinShowTip() and shows the bar. P uses the default cursor, a margin of 0, 6, 0, and 6, and it does not take focus. paintRustPin(AbstractButton) paints P. The pin checkbox starts selected when pinOn is true. The pin field starts with pinNeedle, or with an empty string when that value is null. The field is 16 columns wide. The field and OK are enabled only while the checkbox is selected. The x button clears the field without writing cell states. OK and Enter call commitPin() while the checkbox is selected. The pin tip says the field words filter the canvas. The tip says turning the box on lets you type, and OK writes the states. The tip says turning the box off keeps the words and leaves the states as they are. The field tip says a turn must contain every word. The field tip says Enter does what OK does. The OK tip says a turn that misses a word becomes Excluded. The OK tip says an Excluded turn that matches becomes Included. The OK tip says a matching turn in another state stays in that state. The OK tip says the mood dialog opens after the pins are written. The x tip says the field goes empty, the box stays, and the states wait for OK.
      Returns:
      The return value is the bar that holds v and the pin controls.

    • seatInspectorBody

      private static void seatInspectorBody(SoftWrapArea area)
      The method seatInspectorBody makes the inspector body ignore editing. The area is not editable. The area does not take focus, and it does not ask for focus. The highlighter is cleared. Dragging text is off. The caret is a AetherisNotebookPanel.QuietCaret, so a drag does not open a selection. This method does not replace the scroll pane that owns the wheel.
      Parameters:
      area - The area is the inspector body that should ignore the caret and the keyboard.

    • wrap

      private JComponent wrap(String title, SoftWrapArea area)
      The method wrap builds one inspector column around area. The column is a north header, a scrolling deck, and a south token row. A AetherisNotebookPanel.SnappedHeader stacks factsNote above the control row. The control row is a AetherisNotebookPanel.SnappedFlow holding the title, the soft-wrap box, the wrap-column control, and the line-length control. Soft wrap starts from inspectorSoftWrap. The wrap-column control starts from AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.shellWrapColumns(). A saved wrap count below 1 is treated as 80 before that control is built. The line-length control starts from AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.shellInspectorLineChars(). A saved line length below 1 is treated as 80, and that value is stored in inspectorLineChars. The deck is an AetherisNotebookPanel.InspectorDeck of moodStatus and area. The scroll pane is stored in inspectorPane. The viewport background is #121212. A viewport scroll calls AetherisNotebookPanel.InspectorDeck.followViewport(). A viewport resize revalidates the deck. A press on the body, the mood note, or the deck asks the scroll pane for focus. The south row holds T, which calls openTokenWindow(). The NotebookDip beside that button ignores a settled count, so the ring estimate stays. The soft-wrap tip says long inspector lines fold at the column count. The tip says turning the box off keeps each line on one row and scrolls sideways. The tip says the choice applies to the inspector only. The wrap-column tips say the count is saved with the shell and the smallest count is 1. The line-length tips say preview cuts each kept line to the count, and the count is saved with the shell. A typed count applies after a short pause. The T tip says the ring compares this estimate with the selected model's context window. The T tip says the estimate stays, and this open does not ask the host and does not send.
      Parameters:
      title - The title is the label at the start of the control row.
      area - The area is the inspector body placed in the deck.
      Returns:
      The return value is the column panel.

The caret rests when its rectangle is inside the view after that pad on every side. A caret that crosses the padded edge returns false.

    • gracefulNotice

      private static boolean gracefulNotice(AmwpToon.ErrorBody error)
      The method gracefulNotice reports whether this error already has its own status words. A null error returns false. An error that is not structured returns false. A null reason is read as an empty string. A null message is read as an empty string. A true result means the status line can keep that banner, and the slide is for any other miss. The reason matches air-gap, engine-down, too-large, burner denied, pipe, or no-model. The message matches those same words, except no-model is no model defined on the message. The message also matches grok key missing, unknown provider, unknown role, or no tool is invocable. Any other pair returns false.
      Parameters:

      Returns:
      The return value is true when this miss already has its own words.

    • installErrorSlide

      private void installErrorSlide()
      The method installErrorSlide builds the notice at the top of this pane. The fill is #3A1414, the ink is #F8E8E8, and the edge is #C62828. The title reads Error in the edge color, and it is not opaque. The body is three rows and 24 columns. The body is not editable, it wraps on words, and it is opaque. The body uses the fill, the ink, and an empty border of 4 pixels on top. The body tip says the notice stays until it is closed, and the cell does not keep the text. Close calls hideErrorSlide(). The Close tip says the notice stays until it is closed. The notice border is 2 pixels in the edge color. The notice starts hidden and is added on the north edge. The notice tip says it slides down from the top of the Aetheris pane and stays until it is closed. A negative errorSlideHeight uses the natural preferred height. Any other errorSlideHeight forces that height and keeps the natural width.

    • showErrorSlide

      private void showErrorSlide(String raw)
      The method showErrorSlide opens the notice with the red skin. The call is showErrorSlide(String, boolean) with yellow false. A later miss replaces the text. The cell is not written.
      Parameters:
      raw - The text is the garnered notice. An empty value becomes execute failed.

    • showErrorSlide

      private void showErrorSlide(String raw, boolean yellow)
      The method showErrorSlide opens the notice and replaces its text. A call off the event thread posts the same call back onto that thread and returns. A null notice returns without a change. A null body returns without a change. A null raw is trimmed as an empty string. An empty trim is shown as execute failed. applySlideSkin(boolean) paints yellow when yellow is true and red when it is false. The caret is placed at 0. The notice is shown. A preferred height below 1 uses a target of 1. A notice that was hidden, or whose height is 0, starts the slide from 0. A notice that is already open starts from its current height. slideError(int, boolean) then opens toward that target. The cell is not written.
      Parameters:
      raw - The text is the garnered notice.
      yellow - The flag is true for the yellow skin and false for the red skin.

    • hideErrorSlide

      private void hideErrorSlide()
      The method hideErrorSlide slides the notice shut. A call off the event thread posts the same call back onto that thread and returns. A null notice returns without a change. A notice that is already hidden returns without a change. slideError(int, boolean) then closes toward a height of 0. The text is dropped when that height reaches zero.

    • slideError

      private void slideError(int target, boolean opening)
      The method slideError moves the notice height to target. An existing timer is stopped first. A negative errorSlideHeight starts from the notice's current height. The timer fires every 16 milliseconds. Each step is at least 12 pixels, or one quarter of the remaining distance when that is larger. Opening adds the step, and closing subtracts it. A step that would pass target stops on target. Reaching target stops the timer. A finished close hides the notice, sets the height to -1, clears the hard-skin flag, and clears the text. A finished open sets the height to -1 so the notice uses its natural height.
      Parameters:
      target - The target is the height in pixels.
      opening - The flag is true when the notice is opening and false when it is closing.

Any other connector, including a null connector, contributes raw. A null yaml contributes unset as the air-gap word. Otherwise the air-gap word comes from the yaml. mismatch is added when the session facts are reported, the session air-gap is not null, and that word differs from the yaml word. The engine word comes from AetherisStage2.shownTarget(CellRecord) for targetCell(). A non-empty extra is appended after two spaces. A null or empty extra is left off.
      Parameters:
      extra - The extra is the trailing status text, or null.
      Returns:
      The return value is the status sentence.

The reply area is not editable. The reply area wraps on word boundaries. The reply font is monoFont(). The reply background is black, 0x000000. The reply ink is 0xffff55. Close disposes the window. If the vault is present and ViewBounds.load(String) returns bounds, the window uses those bounds. If no bounds are stored, the window is 720 by 480 and sits relative to this panel. If findCell(String) returns null, the update returns. The execution status becomes FAILED. persistQuiet(CellRecord) stores the cell. absorbConcat(ArrayList) receives a list that holds that cell. saveCells(VaultStore, String, ArrayList) stores the touched cells for that username. rebuildTabs() rebuilds the canvas. refreshInspector() repaints the inspector.

    • absorbConcat

      private void absorbConcat(ArrayList<CellRecord> touched)
      The method absorbConcat fills a merge cell when its input cells have finished. Each touched cell is considered once per group id. A null or empty group id is skipped. The members come from orderedCells(CanvasRecord) on currentCanvas(). A cell at column position 0 is the merge cell. Any other cell in that group is an input member. A null execution status is treated as empty. FAILED or CANCELLED marks the group as failed. Any other status except COMPLETED marks the group as not ready. If the merge cell is absent or the group has no input members, the group is skipped. If the group failed, the merge reply becomes empty and the merge status becomes FAILED. That failed merge is added to touched when it is not already there. persistQuiet(CellRecord) stores the failed merge, and disarmGroupWait(String) stops the group timer. If the group is not ready, the method leaves the merge unchanged. If every input is COMPLETED, the merge reply becomes AetherisStage2.concatJoin(List) of the members. That merge status becomes COMPLETED, the merge is added to touched when needed, and disarmGroupWait(String) runs. The completed merge is not stored by persistQuiet(CellRecord) in this method.
      Parameters:
      touched - The touched list holds cells whose status just changed, and the method may add the merge cell.

    • advanceChain

      private void advanceChain(ArrayList<CellRecord> touched)
      The method advanceChain starts the next cell after the head of the chain finishes. If the chain queue is empty, the method returns. The head is the first id in the queue. If a touched cell has that id and its status is FAILED, the queue is cleared and the method returns. If a touched cell has that id and its status is COMPLETED, the head is finished. If the head is not finished, the method returns. The finished head is removed. If the queue is then empty, the method returns. findCell(String) loads the new head. If that cell is present, dispatchCell(CellRecord) runs it.
      Parameters:
      touched - The touched list holds cells whose status just changed.

    • runChain

      private void runChain()
      The method runChain queues the cells named by prompt markers and then the focused cell. If targetCell() is absent or currentCanvas() is absent, the method returns. AetherisStage2.sourcesBefore(List, CellRecord, boolean) lists the earlier kept cells, and the cloud flag is false. The chain queue is cleared. A null prompt is treated as empty. The scan looks for two opening braces, the word cell, and an opening bracket. The matching end is a closing bracket, a dot, the word output, and two closing braces. The text between them is trimmed and parsed as an integer. If that integer is from 1 through the source count, the source id is added when it is not already queued. A number that is not an integer is ignored. The focused cell id is added after those sources. findCell(String) loads the first queued id. If that cell is present, dispatchCell(CellRecord) runs it.

    • commitPin

      private void commitPin()
      The method commitPin marks cells that match the pin text. AetherisStage2.pinTokens(String) splits pinNeedle. If currentCanvas() is absent, the method returns. A cell that is not readable is skipped. If AetherisStage2.pinMatch(CellRecord, List) is false, the cell state becomes CellState.EXCLUDED. If the cell matches and its state is CellState.EXCLUDED, the state becomes CellState.INCLUDED. A matching cell in any other state keeps that state. persistQuiet(CellRecord) stores every readable cell. rebuildTabs() rebuilds the canvas. refreshInspector() repaints the inspector.

    • openMood

      private void openMood()
      The method openMood opens the mood dialog for one readable cell. moodCard() supplies the cell. If that cell is absent, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.aetherisStatus(String) shows the statusLine(String) for no cell and the method returns. If the focused SshTtyConnector is absent or isAmwp is false, showErrorSlide(String) shows keyword only. in yellow and the status shows the same words. The method stores the cell id, clears the mood turns, clears the busy flag, sets the try count to 0, and clears the wire id. The title is Mood when shortModelName(String) of moodTarget(CellRecord) is empty. Any other title joins Mood to that model name with a middle dot. The dialog is modal and holds a terminal widget of 80 columns and 24 rows. The widget settings are a AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodGlassSettings. The connector is a AetherisNotebookPanel.MoodGlassConnector. If starting the session throws a runtime exception, the widget and the glass are cleared, both are closed, and moodMiss(String, boolean) shows keyword only. in yellow. A close failure on the widget is ignored. If the session starts, the glass paints the transcript. The draft area copies its font, colors, caret, selection, and border from a themed text field. The draft strip reports a preferred height of moodDraftSlide when that value is at least 0, and otherwise a height of 0. The strip starts hidden. An insert, a remove, or a style change on the draft calls syncMoodDraft(). Clear calls confirmClearMood(JDialog) and, on yes, clearMoodSession(). Approve trims the draft. If that text is non-empty and differs from the trimmed saved line, moodPending becomes true. A non-empty draft becomes the saved line, and the switch is turned on when it was off. Approve then calls syncMoodSwitch(), saveMoodStore(), and noteMoodRelay(). Approve and Cancel both call closeMoodDialog() and refreshInspector(). An empty draft still closes the dialog and does not write the saved line. When the window opens, the terminal widget requests the focus. If this dialog is still the open mood dialog, a window close calls closeMoodDialog() and refreshInspector(). If another dialog has replaced it, the close event returns. The checkbox labeled SSH Mood Active starts from sshMoodOn(String) for openUsername(). The checkbox is enabled only when that username is non-empty. A change calls setSshMoodUser(String, boolean). AetherisNotebookPanel.ThinkSpinner is the footer clock. A resize calls syncMoodDraft(). The terminal widget fills the center. The draft strip and the footer fill the south. If moodDialogSizeKept() is true, the window uses the saved width and height. If no size is kept, the window is 760 by 520. If moodHasLine() is true, the draft shows the trimmed saved line. The window opens relative to this panel.

    • paintClearChoice

      private static void paintClearChoice(JButton button, Color fill, Color ink)
      The method paintClearChoice paints a clear-ask button wide enough for its word. The client property aetheris.choice becomes true. If the current preferred height is greater than 0, that height is kept. The preferred, minimum, and maximum sizes are cleared so an earlier short width is dropped. The button uses a basic button UI. The background is fill and the foreground is ink. The button is opaque, the content area is filled, and the focus is not painted. The margin is 0 on every side. The border is a raised bevel in a darker fill and black, plus an empty pad of 4, 12, 4, and 12. A null label is treated as empty. The spare width is the width of M, and that spare is at least 1. The width is the label width, the left and right insets, and two spare widths. The height is the larger of the kept height and the text height plus the vertical insets. The preferred size and the minimum size are that width and height. The maximum width is the largest integer, and the maximum height is that height.
      Parameters:

      fill - The fill is the background color.
      ink - The ink is the word color.

      the id for this frame

    • sendMood

      private void sendMood()
      The method sendMood sends the mood chat for the stored card. If a mood send is already in flight, the method returns. If findCell(String) misses the stored card id, or the cell is not readable, moodMiss(String, boolean) shows keyword only. in yellow. If the focused SshTtyConnector is absent or isAmwp is false, the same yellow notice is shown. openMoodWire() supplies a new wire id. The execute body uses that wire id, moodTarget(CellRecord) for the card, and the card's ephemeral flag. If the provider is grok, the body copies the cell entry from grokDoc. The Grok burner-cloud flag is true only when that entry is present and its flag is true. The Grok think stream is false. The model id is the text after the slash. If that id is empty and the entry has a model, the id becomes the trimmed entry model. GrokSettingsDocument.normalizeEffort(String, String) sets the reasoning effort from that id. If the entry is absent, the effort passed in is empty. If the entry is present, the effort passed in is the stored effort. If the entry is absent, the send-effort flag is GrokSettingsDocument.sendsEffort(String). If the entry is present, the send-effort flag is the stored flag. The temperature is marked present. If the entry is absent, the temperature is 1.0. If the entry is present, the temperature is the stored temperature. The completion cap is marked present. If the entry is absent, the completion cap is 128000. If the entry is present, the completion cap is the stored cap. If the provider is pool, the body boot id is poolBootId. Any other provider adds none of those Grok or pool fields. The working set starts with a system turn whose text is the mood-shape instruction. appendMoodHeader(AmwpToon.ExecuteBody) adds the saved mood turns. Each turn already in the mood chat is then added. AmwpToon.encodeExecute(AmwpToon.ExecuteBody) encodes the body. If AmwpCodec.fits(byte[]) is false, moodShapeTooLarge() runs and the method returns before the busy flag is set. The busy flag becomes true and moodSpinStart() starts the dialog clock. The worker writes AmwpCodec.scopeAPayload(int, int, byte[], byte[]) of 0, 1, the id bytes, and the encoded body. The write uses channel A and the data type on the connector. If that write throws, moodMiss(String, boolean) shows keyword only. in yellow. If the exception message is non-blank after trim, that trimmed message is appended to the notice.

    • appendMoodReply

      private void appendMoodReply(String text)
      The method appendMoodReply stores one mood reply and looks for a mood line. The busy flag becomes false and moodSpinStop() hides the dialog clock. If the glass is absent or the draft is absent, the method returns. An assistant turn is added, and a null reply is stored as empty. If moodPluck(String) returns a non-empty line, the draft becomes that line, the try count becomes 0, and the glass paints the transcript. If the plucked line is empty, the try count increases by 1. If the try count is still below 3, a user turn with the format request is added, the glass paints, and sendMood() runs again. If the try count reaches 3, the glass paints and showErrorSlide(String) shows keyword only. mood line in yellow. That third miss also shows the statusLine(String) for keyword only.
      Parameters:
      text - The text is the assistant reply, and it may be null.

    • runSearch

      private void runSearch()
      The method runSearch finds cells on the showing canvas that match the search text. If currentCanvas() is absent or the vault is absent, the method returns. A null needle is treated as empty. The worker calls the vault search with the canvas id and that needle. If the hit list is empty, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.aetherisStatus(String) shows the statusLine(String) for no hits. The first hit id is the fallback. The first cell from orderedCells(CanvasRecord) whose id is in the hit list replaces that fallback. The pending focus id and the focused cell id both become that pick. rebuildTabs() rebuilds the canvas. The status then shows search plus the hit count. If the search throws SQLException, the status shows search failed: plus the exception message.

    • exportCanvas

      private void exportCanvas()
      The method exportCanvas writes the showing canvas to a chosen file. If currentCanvas() is absent, the method returns. The confirm dialog asks Keep burner bodies? under the title Export. Cancel and a closed dialog both return. AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.chooseRememberedFile(Component) supplies the file. If that file is absent, the method returns. Yes passes true to AetherisStage2.exportToon(String, List, boolean), and No passes false. The arguments are the canvas name and orderedCells(CanvasRecord). The file receives that text as UTF-8 bytes. AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.aetherisStatus(String) shows the statusLine(String) for exported. If the write throws IOException, the status shows export failed: plus the exception message. The stream is closed, and an IOException from close is ignored.

    • importCanvas

      private void importCanvas()
      The method importCanvas appends cells from a chosen file onto the showing canvas. If currentCanvas() is absent or the vault is absent, the method returns. AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.chooseRememberedFile(Component) supplies the file. If that file is absent, the method returns. If the file length is greater than 1,024 times 1,024 bytes, the status shows import refused: over 1 MiB and the worker returns. The worker reads the file bytes and decodes them as UTF-8. AetherisStage2.importToon(String, String) parses that text for this canvas id. If the parsed list is empty, the status shows import refused: version. Each imported cell gets the next turn index after the cells already on the canvas. The vault stores the cell, and the canvas cell list and order both gain the id. The vault stores the order. The Swing thread calls rebuildTabs() and refreshInspector(). The status then shows imported plus the imported count. If the read or the save throws, the status shows import failed: plus the exception message. The stream is closed, and an IOException from close is ignored.

    • pullCrosstalk

      private void pullCrosstalk()
      The method pullCrosstalk adds an excluded cell from the terminal text. If currentCanvas() is absent or the vault is absent, the method returns. If the terminal selection is non-blank after trim, that selection is the text. If the selection is blank, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.terminalLastLine() supplies the text. If the text is absent or blank after trim, the status shows the statusLine(String) for no terminal line. The worker adds a turn at the next index after the current cell count. The new cell state is CellState.EXCLUDED. The user text is the chosen terminal text. The vault stores the cell, and the canvas cell list and order both gain the id. The vault stores the order. The Swing thread sets the pending focus id and the focused cell id to the new cell. rebuildTabs() and refreshInspector() then run. The status shows the status line for pulled excluded. If the save throws SQLException, the status shows pull failed: plus the exception message.

    • pushPty

      private void pushPty()
      The method pushPty sends the focused cell text to the terminal. If targetCell() is absent, the method returns. TerminalPaste.decide(boolean, String, String) chooses the body from the ephemeral flag, the reply, and the prompt. If the kind is TerminalPaste.Kind.EPHEMERAL, the status shows the statusLine(String) for ephemeral and the method returns. If the kind is TerminalPaste.Kind.EMPTY, the method returns without a status line. If the kind is TerminalPaste.Kind.OVER_CAP, the status shows Paste exceeds, the character cap, and characters. AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.confirmPtyWrite(Component, String) asks with preview(String, int) of the body at 120 characters. If the confirm is declined, the method returns. AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.sendTerminalPaste(String) writes the body. The status then shows the status line for sent to terminal. If the write throws IOException, the status shows terminal write failed: plus the exception message.

    • promoteGroup

      private void promoteGroup(CellRecord cell)
      The method promoteGroup turns a lone cell into a group with a new merge cell. If the cell is absent, the method returns. If the group id is already non-empty, the method returns. If currentCanvas() is absent or the vault is absent, the method returns. The cell receives a new random group id and column position 1. The worker adds a turn at the next index after the current cell count. That new cell is the merge cell, with the same group id and column position 0. The vault stores both cells. The merge id is inserted just after the original cell in the canvas order. If the original id is missing from the order, the merge id is appended. The canvas cell list gains the merge cell. snapGroup(CanvasRecord, String) and the vault order save then run. The Swing thread calls rebuildTabs() and refreshInspector(). If the save throws SQLException, AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.aetherisStatus(String) shows group failed: plus the exception message.
      Parameters:
      cell - The cell is the lone turn being grouped, and it may be null.

    • joinGroup

      private void joinGroup(CellRecord cell)
      The method joinGroup moves one cell into the armed group. If the cell is absent or the armed source id is absent, the method returns. If findCell(String) misses that source, or the source group id is null or empty, the method returns. If the cell id equals the source id, the method returns. If currentCanvas() is absent, the method returns. The new column position is one past the highest column position already in that group. The cell takes the source group id and that column position. snapGroup(CanvasRecord, String) reorders the group. persistQuiet(CellRecord) stores the cell. saveOrderQuiet(CanvasRecord) stores the canvas order. rebuildTabs() rebuilds the canvas.
      Parameters:
      cell - The cell is the turn being joined, and it may be null.

    • ungroup

      private void ungroup(CellRecord cell)
      The method ungroup removes one cell from its group. If the cell is absent, the method returns. The cell group id becomes empty and the column position becomes 0. persistQuiet(CellRecord) stores that cell. If the old group id was null or empty, rebuildTabs() runs and the method is done. If currentCanvas() is absent, rebuildTabs() runs and the method returns. A remaining cell at column position 0 is the merge cell. Every other remaining cell in that group counts as a member. If no members remain and a merge cell remains, that merge cell also gets an empty group id and column position 0. persistQuiet(CellRecord) stores that cleared merge cell. If members remain, snapGroup(CanvasRecord, String) reorders the group and saveOrderQuiet(CanvasRecord) stores the order. rebuildTabs() rebuilds the canvas.
      Parameters:
      cell - The cell is the turn leaving the group, and it may be null.

    • seatThinkDelta

      private void seatThinkDelta(String username, String cellId, char kind, String text)
      The method seats one thinking chunk on that user's pane. If the strip is absent, the kind is not t, or the text is null or empty, the method returns. If the cell id is 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000, the method returns. An open vault reads the cell from the loaded canvases and remembers that face. Any other vault uses the face stored when the run was armed. A missing face returns without writing. A grok provider returns unless the stored AetherisNotebookPanel.CellThink is present and grokOn is true. A pool provider returns unless the stored AetherisNotebookPanel.CellThink is present and poolOn is true. The banner word is shortModelName(String) of the execution target. If that name is empty, the banner word is the provider id. ThinkSeats.word(String) then drops a newline and a box-drawing character. A merge group shares one pane. A single prompt uses the cell id alone. A different cell or a different model starts a header. The same cell and the same model append. The glass is painted only when this scope is the pane already on the strip. A chunk for the armed scope of the open user, while another pane is on the glass, captures that pane and then shows this one. The user's file is written after the chunk. Another user's file is not opened.
      Parameters:
      username - the sanitized user that owns the cell
      cellId - The cell id is the cell that produced the chunk.
      kind - The kind is the stream letter, and only t is seated here.
      text - The text is the chunk, and it may be null.

    • applySlideSkin

      private void applySlideSkin(boolean yellow)
      The method applySlideSkin paints the error slide red or yellow. The hard flag becomes the opposite of yellow. A red slide uses edge 0xc62828, fill 0x3a1414, and ink 0xf8e8e8. A yellow slide uses edge 0xf9a825, fill 0x3a3014, and ink 0xf8f4e8. If the slide panel is present, its background becomes the fill and its border becomes a 2-pixel line in the edge color. If the body is present, its background becomes the fill and its foreground becomes the ink. If the title is present, its foreground becomes the edge color. A missing panel, body, or title is left untouched.
      Parameters:

    • hardMiss

      private static boolean hardMiss(String reason, String message)
      The method hardMiss reports whether the failure text is a strict failure. A null reason is treated as empty. A null message is treated as empty. If either text equals engine-down, the method returns true. If either text equals too-large, the method returns true. If the reason equals pool down, pool parse, or pool payload, the method returns true. If the message starts with pool down, pool parse, or pool payload, the method returns true. If the message starts with Grok and does not start with Grok HTTP, the method returns true. Any other pair returns false.
      Parameters:
      reason - The reason is the error token, and it may be null.
      message - The message is the error text, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the failure is one of those strict texts.

    • softMiss

      private static boolean softMiss(String reason, String message)
      The method softMiss reports whether the failure text is a yellow-slide failure. A null reason is treated as empty. A null message is treated as empty. If either text equals air-gap, the method returns true. If either text equals burner denied, the method returns true. If either text equals pipe, the method returns true. If the reason equals no-model, or the message equals no model defined, the method returns true. If the message equals grok key missing or grok empty content, the method returns true. If the message equals unknown provider or unknown role, the method returns true. If the message equals no tool is invocable, the method returns true. If the message equals the cell is still waiting and no answer arrived, the method returns true. If the reason equals pool auth or pool tool refused, the method returns true. If the message starts with pool auth or pool tool refused, the method returns true. If the message starts with Grok HTTP, the method returns true. Any other pair returns false.
      Parameters:
      reason - The reason is the error token, and it may be null.
      message - The message is the error text, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the failure is one of those texts.

    • groupedMember

      private boolean groupedMember(String cellId)
      The method groupedMember reports whether a cell is an input member of a group. findCell(String) loads the cell. The method returns true when the cell is present, the group id is non-empty, and the column position is greater than 0. A missing cell, an empty group id, and a merge cell at column position 0 all return false.
      Parameters:
      cellId - The cell id is the id to test.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when the cell is a grouped input member.

    • syncGrokTargets

      private void syncGrokTargets(List<CanvasRecord> loaded)
      The method syncGrokTargets writes each stored Grok model back onto its cell target. If the canvas list is absent, the method returns. A cell whose provider is not grok is skipped. A missing document entry is skipped. A null or empty entry model is skipped. The next target is grok/ plus that model. If the cell target already equals that text, the cell is left as it is. If the text differs, the execution target becomes that text and persistQuiet(CellRecord) stores the cell.
      Parameters:
      loaded - The loaded list is the canvases just opened, and it may be null.

    • nearestGrok

      private GrokSettingsDocument.Entry nearestGrok(CellRecord cell)
      The method nearestGrok returns the nearest earlier Grok entry with a model. orderedCells(CanvasRecord) supplies the order of currentCanvas(). The cell index is the last row whose id equals this cell id. The search starts at the row before that index and moves toward the start. The first GrokSettingsDocument.Entry whose model is non-empty is returned. If the cell is not in the order, that search does not run. If no earlier entry has a model, the method returns null.
      Parameters:
      cell - The cell is the turn being edited.
      Returns:
      The return value is that earlier entry, or null when none qualifies.

    • syncGrokModelFromField

      private void syncGrokModelFromField(CellRecord cell)
      The method syncGrokModelFromField copies the field model into the Grok entry. If the cell is absent, the method returns. If AetherisStage2.providerId(String) is not grok, the method returns. If grokDoc has no entry for the cell id, the method returns. The model id is AetherisStage2.modelAfterSlash(String) of the execution target. If that id is empty or already equals the entry model, the method returns. The entry model becomes that id. The reasoning effort becomes GrokSettingsDocument.normalizeEffort(String, String) of the new model and the stored effort. grokDoc.write stores the entry, and the third argument is false.
      Parameters:
      cell - The cell is the turn whose target field changed, and it may be null.

      private static String numberText(double value)
      The method numberText prints a double without a trailing fraction when the value is a whole number. If the value equals its nearest integer and is not infinite, the method returns that value cast to a long. Any other value is returned from Double.toString.
      Parameters:

    • armGroupWait

      private void armGroupWait(CellRecord stored)
      The method armGroupWait starts a one-shot timer after a grouped cell completes. If the cell is absent, or its group id is null or empty, the method returns. If the execution status is not COMPLETED, the method returns. If a timer is already stored for that group id, the method returns. If groupHasWaiter(String) is false, the method returns. The timer waits 1,800,000 milliseconds and does not repeat. When the timer fires, it stops, the stored timer is removed, and fireGroupWait(String) runs. The timer is stored under the group id and then started.
      Parameters:
      stored - The stored cell is the cell that just completed, and it may be null.

    • disarmGroupWait

      private void disarmGroupWait(String groupId)
      The method disarmGroupWait stops the group timer when no input cell is still open. If groupHasWaiter(String) is true, the method returns and leaves the timer running. If no timer is stored for the group id, the method returns. A stored timer is removed and stopped.
      Parameters:
      groupId - The group id is the group whose timer may stop.

    • groupHasWaiter

      private boolean groupHasWaiter(String groupId)
      The method groupHasWaiter reports whether a group still has an unfinished input cell. If the group id is null or empty, the method returns false. If currentCanvas() is absent, the method returns false. orderedCells(CanvasRecord) supplies the cells. A cell in another group is skipped. A cell at column position 0 is skipped. A null execution status is treated as empty. If that status is not COMPLETED, FAILED, or CANCELLED, the method returns true. If every input cell has one of those three statuses, the method returns false.
      Parameters:
      groupId - The group id is the group to test, and it may be null.
      Returns:
      The return value is true when an input cell is still unfinished.

    • fireGroupWait

      private void fireGroupWait(String groupId)
      The method fireGroupWait fails the input cells that are still unfinished. If currentCanvas() is absent, the method returns. orderedCells(CanvasRecord) supplies the cells. A cell in another group is skipped. A cell at column position 0 is skipped. A null execution status is treated as empty. A status of COMPLETED, FAILED, or CANCELLED is skipped. Every other input cell becomes FAILED, persistQuiet(CellRecord) stores it, and the cell is added to the touched list. If no cell was touched, the method returns. AetherisNotebookPanel.Host.aetherisStatus(String) shows the statusLine(String) for the cell is still waiting and no answer arrived. showErrorSlide(String) shows those same words in yellow. absorbConcat(ArrayList) receives the touched cells. saveCells(VaultStore, String, ArrayList) stores them for openUsername(). rebuildTabs() and refreshInspector() then run.
      Parameters:
      groupId - The group id is the group whose wait expired.
